integrity: All displayed finite-field tests were actually executed on the original brackets; arithmetic tests are corroboration, while the algebraic proof supplies the general result. First public source date follows arXiv:1209.1289v1.
scientific_limitations: Reduced commuting varieties of one explicitly presented four-dimensional Chevalley positive-root Lie algebra, m>=2. No assertions about nonreduced defining schemes, group orbits, other root systems or exhaustive historical uniqueness. Independent audit not performed.
title: Bad-prime component collapse in commuting tuples of the \(B_2\) positive-root Lie algebra
